d:
Mokama se bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi ko lekar unke paitrik ganv ladma men taiyariyan jor-shor se chal rahi hain. aagami 25 navanbar ko hone vali is shadi ki in dinon pure bihar men kaphi charcha ho rahi hai.
4 lakh se adhik mehmanon ke aane ki sanbhavna, karoron rupye ho rahe kharch
